preserve.details: Mountain ridgeline; snow lights; three visible river bends and both banks; nearest fir silhouettes; monochrome values.

direction.instruction: Keep the original monochrome scene and framing. Preserve the mountain ridgeline, snow lights, river bends and nearest fir-tree silhouettes. Group fine foliage into quieter connected tones without moving contours. Do not increase global contrast, invent objects, colourise, or add paper texture. Preserve the existing composition if no change is justified.

preserveRequirements: Existing river/bank curves and foreground silhouettes
Monochrome tonal hierarchy; no invented original colours
requestedChanges: Reduce tiny foliage/surface detail within existing masses
Retain a photographic reference appearance; a minimal/no-change outcome is valid
unacceptableAlterations: Forests removed rather than simplified within the existing silhouette
Colourisation, new buildings, paper texture, arbitrary global contrast increase
cases.inputInspectionNotes: The supplied photograph already has strong composition. Judge whether reduced microtexture helps a broad wash/value plan without weakening that organisation.

preserve.details: House/roof proportions, all visible openings and columns, porch/steps, tree-trunk positions and the existing occlusions.

direction.instruction: Keep the house proportions, roof planes, visible column/window spacing, porch and steps. Keep the foreground tree trunks in place; do not invent wall or window details behind them. Quiet minor leaves and grass within their current masses. Keep monochrome values and a photographic reference; do not redesign the house or remove its trees.

preserveRequirements: Building proportions and receding wall/roof edge families
Count/spacing of visible columns, openings, shutters and steps
Foreground trunks and their occlusion of the building
requestedChanges: Simplify small leaf, grass and lattice texture conservatively
Optional explicit local crop trims scan border only after owner preview
unacceptableAlterations: Invented windows/columns, changed perspective or room/roof geometry
Revealing fabricated architecture behind removed trunks
New decoration, colourisation or global sharpening
cases.inputInspectionNotes: The real input includes scan borders/catalogue writing and foreground occlusion. Do not treat invented hidden facade details as a useful improvement.

rights.permittedTestScopePendingOwnerApproval: Private educational staging evaluation only; no publication or endorsement

preserve.details: Main rose identity, visible petal arrangement and silhouette; pink hue and highlights; stem and visible leaves.

direction.instruction: Keep the main pink rose, its petal arrangement, outer silhouette, stem and visible leaves. Retain its pink hue and natural highlights. Quiet the competing magenta/red background blooms and minor background detail without moving them or erasing the main flower. Do not add petals, change the main bloom into another flower, or apply a decorative painted texture.

preserveRequirements: Main bloom position, petal-layer relationships and silhouette
Stem direction and visible leaf geometry
Main rose pink hue and highlights
requestedChanges: Keep the primary rose readable without uniformly increasing contrast
unacceptableAlterations: Invented/duplicated petal structures or missing outer petals
Main bloom hue replaced, stem/leaf anatomy distorted
All-colour desaturation or blur falsely presented as semantic editing
cases.inputInspectionNotes: Compare the main rose with the bright blurred blooms above it. A useful result quiets that competition while keeping the primary flower recognisable.

preserve.details: Face/expression/age/hair; hands/fingers/rings; suit and patches; flag; table; shuttle model geometry and markings.

direction.instruction: Keep Eileen Collins recognisable and unchanged: face, expression, age, hair, pose, hands and fingers. Keep the flight suit, insignia/name patch, flag, table and shuttle model in their positions. Only quiet small backdrop/cloth texture. No beautification, facial reshaping, extra fingers, changed lettering or new objects. Do not imply NASA endorsement.

preserveRequirements: Recognisable face, expression, hair and apparent age
Pose, hands/fingers, rings and body proportions
Shuttle model geometry, placement, markings and supporting table
requestedChanges: No editing of face, anatomy, text, model geometry or insignia
unacceptableAlterations: Invented/duplicated fingers, limbs, model parts or lettering
Changed insignia/name patch, endorsement implication, new objects
cases.inputInspectionNotes: This is a sensitive fidelity test, not a face-enhancement request. Copyright public domain does not establish a model release or permission to imply endorsement.
